after_static_pass: freeze one all-five-title M3 research model with the exact T001 recipe, fit twice independently, require bitwise equal predictions
runtime differential broad vs production v1 vs gen2 held-out rank-budget explicit plan on the five source-backed titles
historical runtime-only falsifier on authorized SEG-046 titles (no static completeness claim)
economics: R/ROM, K/U, generated C, compile CPU, wall, RSS, inference time
evidence_status: the five titles are NOT blind (T001 exposed their FRF); this is calibration engineering on a known corpus, not fresh blind generalization proof

frozen_from.score_reuse: private T001 outer M3 score arrays are reused only if their prediction digests equal outer_score_digests

gates.choice: the SMALLEST budget among B30..B50 passing every R and K gate on all five outer titles; none -> GEN2_CALIBRATION_UNSOLVED and stop

k_stage.attribution: C outside R separated from post-ML pruning losses (POST_ML_PRUNING_BLOCKER); M3 is never retrained to mask them

r_stage.rank_headroom: nominal budget fraction (percent/100) / FRF of the held-out fold

not_done: no probability calibration family unless every rank policy fails
no native inference, no launcher/default-policy change

policy.cell_count_rule: N = ceil(cells * percent / 100) in integer arithmetic; cells = ceil(rom_bytes / 128)
policy.ranking: scores descending, then cell ordinal ascending; ordinal is a deterministic tie-break only, never a model input
policy.region: R = rank-selected cells UNION certain-code seed cells (cells holding a precise direct-control-discovery identity)
policy.score: the float64 sigmoid probability of the M3 logit as produced in T001 (identical ranking to the logit; saturated ties, if any, sit at the top of the ranking and are resolved by the ordinal tie-break)
policy.uniform: one budget for every ROM; no per-ROM budget; no additional budgets may be evaluated

scope: OFFLINE research; production Optimized AOT and SEG-047 v1 artifacts are unchanged; M3 is frozen exactly as in T001
